tutorial.title: Transactions
tutorial.descriptionContent: Learn how to run multiple queries using SQLite in Express

lessons.title: Lesson #1
lessons.interactiveContent:
Transactions allow us to execute multiple database queries as a single unit of work, ensuring data integrity and speeding up the process.

Let's learn how to efficiently manage transactions.

lessons.title: Lesson #2
lessons.interactiveContent:
Often, we want to add multiple values at once. We can achieve that using multiple values with the INSERT INTO statement.

Make sure to pick INSERT, followed by INTO, and finally VALUES.
lessons.hardModeContent:
You can add multiple rows at once by providing multiple sets of values in an INSERT INTO statement.

Make sure to pick INSERT, followed by INTO, and finally VALUES.

lessons.title: Lesson #3
lessons.interactiveContent:
To use a transaction, we need a statement first. We start by preparing a parameterized query.

Make sure to pick db followed by .prepare and then INSERT, INTO, VALUES.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Before using a transaction, prepare a parameterized statement.

Make sure to pick db, followed by .prepare, INSERT, INTO, and finally VALUES.

lessons.title: Lesson #3 - Copy
lessons.interactiveContent:
Transactions group multiple database statements so that they either all succeed or fail together.

To group statements into a single transaction, we use db.transaction, which takes a callback function to execute all of them together.

Make sure to pick db, followed by .transaction.

lessons.title: Lesson #3 - Copy - Copy
lessons.interactiveContent:
To prepare for adding multiple names in a single transaction, we use a callback function that loops through the array.

Inside the loop, we set up each name to be added as part of one grouped operation.

Make sure to pick names, followed by for (const name of names), and finally insertFriend.run(name).
lessons.hardModeContent:
To add multiple names in one transaction, use a callback function that loops through the array.

Inside the loop, set up each name to be added as part of one grouped operation.

Make sure to pick names, followed by for (const name of names), and finally insertFriend.run(name).

lessons.title: Lesson #3 - Copy - Copy - Copy
lessons.interactiveContent:
To execute the transaction, we pass an array, triggering the loop inside the callback to prepare each element for insertion.

Elements will be added immediately because the transaction directly calls the prepared statement for each element.

Make sure to pick insertTransaction, followed by newFriends.
lessons.hardModeContent:
To execute the transaction, pass an array. This runs the callback loop, inserting each element.

Elements will be added immediately because the transaction directly calls the prepared statement for each element.

Make sure to pick insertTransaction, followed by newFriends.

lessons.title: Lesson #3 - Copy - Copy - Copy - Copy
lessons.interactiveContent:
To ensure that our transaction is working as expected. Let's retrieve and display all entries in our database.

Prepare a statement that we can run to get all entries.

Make sure to pick db followed by . and then prepare, SELECT, *, FROM, friends.
lessons.hardModeContent:
To ensure that our transaction is working as expected. Let's retrieve and display all entries in our database.

Prepare a statement that we can run to get all entries.

Make sure to pick db, followed by ., prepare, SELECT, *, FROM, and finally friends.

lessons.title: Lesson #7
lessons.interactiveContent:
Transactions also help with error handling. If any query within a transaction fails, all queries are rolled back, maintaining consistency.

In this case, the name "Chandler" can't be added again as name is marked as UNIQUE.

Make sure to pick try followed by catch and then error, error, ., message.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Transactions also help with error handling. If any query within a transaction fails, all queries are rolled back, maintaining consistency.

In this case, the name "Chandler" can't be added again as name is marked as UNIQUE.

Put the call in try. Use catch (error) to handle failure and error.message for its details.

Run the grouped transaction with newFriends so a failure rolls back every added name.

Make sure to pick try, followed by insertTransaction, catch, error, error, and finally .message.

lessons.title: Lesson #3 - Copy - Copy
lessons.interactiveContent:
Adding rows with multiple columns, like name and age, requires separating the values with a comma.

In the loop, we pass the name and age to the prepared statement as separate arguments, ensuring each pair is inserted correctly.

Make sure to pick , followed by ( and then 'Chandler',, 32, ), friend.name, friend.age.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Adding rows with multiple columns, like name and age, requires separating the values with a comma.

In the loop, pass the name and age as separate arguments to the prepared statement to insert each pair correctly.

Add Chandler aged 32 first, then bind each friend’s name before their age.

Make sure to pick ,, followed by (, 'Chandler',, 32, ), friend.name, and finally friend.age.

lessons.title: Lesson #11
lessons.interactiveContent:
What happens if a query fails within a transaction?

All operations are rolled backOnly the failed query is revertedThe entire database is deletedThe transaction proceeds with remaining queries

All operations are rolled back.
lessons.hardModeContent:
A transaction inserts three rows, but the third insert violates a UNIQUE constraint.

After the error, how many of those three rows were added?

None of them, because the transaction is rolled back.The first two rows only.All three rows, with the duplicate renamed.The database table is deleted.

None of them, because the transaction is rolled back.

Consider this transaction code block. What is its purpose?

Increase the salaries of employees with specific roles Decreasing all salaries by the given amountsAdding new employees with those salariesDeleting employees based on their roles

When this transaction processes the Designer entry, what happens to the matching row?

Its salary increases by 3000.Its salary decreases by 3000.A new Designer row is inserted with salary 3000.The Designer row is deleted.

lessons.title: Lesson #15
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which SQL statement is used within a transaction to execute an update query in SQLite?

db.prepare("UPDATE tableName SET column = value WHERE condition")db.transaction('"UPDATE tableName SET column = value WHERE condition")db.execute("UPDATE tableName SET column = value WHERE condition")db.commit("UPDATE tableName SET column = value WHERE condition")

db.prepare("UPDATE tableName SET column = value WHERE condition").
lessons.hardModeContent:
Which SQL statement is prepared inside the transaction to update a matching user row?

const change = db.prepare("UPDATE users SET name = ? WHERE id = ?");const change = db.transaction("UPDATE users SET name = ? WHERE id = ?");const change = db.execute("UPDATE users SET name = ? WHERE id = ?");const change = db.commit("UPDATE users SET name = ? WHERE id = ?");

const change = db.prepare("UPDATE users SET name = ? WHERE id = ?");.
